name: kicad2ems
description: Trace impedance map and EM simulation (S-parameters) of the open board
description_full: The open board seen from above with every trace coloured by how far its impedance is from its net class's target (kicad2ems's line model; Zdiff for pairs), read on hover. Pick nets, a pair or a region and ports, and simulate them with kicad2ems (the line model, gfdtd's FDTD; openEMS and mom25d where installed), the S-parameters against the line model's. Needs KiCad's API enabled (Preferences > Plugins). On first use KiCad builds the plugin's Python environment, with kicad2ems in it: this takes a few minutes.
